Met circa 1.200 collega’s, 70 boutiques en een sterke positie in e-commerce en wholesale gaan we een volgende internationale groeifase in. Onze ambities zijn hoog en onze mensen maken daarin het verschil. In iedere rol en binnen elk onderdeel van de organisatie dragen collega’s bij aan het succes en de uitstraling van ons merk. Onze ondernemende energie, onderscheidende cultuur en aandacht voor elkaar vormen samen onze kracht. Als Head of People & Culture ben je lid van het MT en medeverantwoordelijk voor het succes van My Jewellery als geheel. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de volledige HR-agenda, rapporteert aan de COO en geeft leiding aan een team van circa 15 FTE binnen HR Operations, HR Advies, L&D en Recruitment. Samen met het team bouw je aan een performancegerichte, internationaal schaalbare organisatie die onmiskenbaar My Jewellery blijft. Duurzame groei vraagt om de juiste mensen op de juiste plek, sterk leiderschap en een omgeving waarin mensen kansen krijgen, blijven leren en vooruitgang boeken. Als Head of People & Culture zorg je dat onze organisatie, ons leiderschap en onze manier van werken zich in hetzelfde tempo ontwikkelen als onze ambities. Je vertaalt de bedrijfsstrategie naar concrete keuzes over organisatie, leiderschap, talent, performance en beloning voor onze boutiques, operationele teams en HQ-organisatie. Je positioneert HR als richtinggevende partner voor C-level en het MT, maakt zichtbaar wat nodig is, durft bestaande keuzes ter discussie te stellen en bepaalt waarop we voortbouwen, wat beter moet en waar een andere aanpak nodig is. Jouw verantwoordelijkheden Organisatie, leiderschap, cultuur & performance: je brengt onze groeistrategie tot leven in de organisatiestructuur, het leiderschap en de kennis en vaardigheden die daarvoor nodig zijn. Je bouwt aan een manier van werken met heldere doelen, eigenaarschap, regelmatige feedback en consequent leiderschap. Je kijkt kritisch naar rollen, processen en bezetting en helpt My Jewellery om met meer focus, eenvoud en sterkere teams betere resultaten te realiseren. Samen met het MT geef je richting aan hoe AI en automatisering binnen de hele organisatie worden ingezet en wat dit vraagt van functies, teams, vaardigheden en bezetting. Je stimuleert een cultuur waarin we continu blijven verbeteren. De lat ligt hoog, maar we werken samen, helpen elkaar en nemen verantwoordelijkheid voor het gezamenlijke resultaat. Talent, ontwikkeling & beloning: je zorgt dat My Jewellery de mensen aantrekt, ontwikkelt en behoudt die we nu en in de toekomst nodig hebben, in onze boutiques, het distributiecentrum tot het hoofdkantoor en leidinggevende posities. Je verbetert hoe we collega’s werven en onboarden, creëert duidelijke ontwikkel- en doorgroeimogelijkheden en zorgt voor sterke leiders en goede opvolging op sleutelposities. Daarbij vind je de juiste balans tussen kansen voor eigen talent en het gericht aantrekken van nieuwe kennis en ervaring. Beloning & incentives: je ontwikkelt onze beloning en incentives verder, zodat performance en impact herkenbaar meetellen. De keuzes die je maakt zijn duidelijk en uitlegbaar, helpen uitzonderlijk talent te behouden en zijn bruikbaar in de verschillende landen waarin we actief zijn. Een HR-team dat vooruitkijkt: je brengt HR Operations, HR Advies, L&D en Recruitment samen in één sterk team met heldere prioriteiten, duidelijk eigenaarschap en een hoog kwaliteitsniveau. Je leidt de beweging van reactief ondersteunen naar proactief adviseren: HR kijkt vooruit, signaleert wat de organisatie nodig heeft en wordt vroeg betrokken bij keuzes over groei, verandering, performance en bezetting. Verantwoordelijkheid bij leiderschap: managers blijven verantwoordelijk voor het leiderschap, de ontwikkeling en de resultaten van hun teams. HR biedt duidelijke kaders, relevante inzichten, expertise en praktische ondersteuning, zodat zij die verantwoordelijkheid goed kunnen waarmaken. Internationaal fundament & people insights: je bouwt een HR-operating model dat internationale groei ondersteunt en ook sterk genoeg is voor de fase daarna. Processen, systemen en beleid worden schaalbaar, compliant en zo veel mogelijk consistent, met ruimte voor relevante lokale verschillen en een herkenbare ervaring voor kandidaten en medewerkers. Je zorgt voor betrouwbare inzichten in performance, talent, capaciteit en betrokkenheid, zodat belangrijke beslissingen over mensen en teams worden onderbouwd met data, context en professioneel oordeel. Wat jij meebrengt Je beschikt over wo-werk- en -denkniveau en hebt minimaal 15 jaar relevante HR-ervaring, waarvan meerdere jaren in een eindverantwoordelijke HR-leiderschapsrol; Je hebt een multidisciplinair HR-team van vergelijkbare omvang geleid en aantoonbaar naar een hoger niveau gebracht; Je hebt HR-leiderschapservaring in zowel een snelgroeiende, ondernemende omgeving als een internationale organisatie met meer schaal, meerdere landen en verder ontwikkelde processen. Ervaring met retail en verschillende medewerkerspopulaties, van boutiques en het distributiecentrum tot hoofdkantoor, is een sterke pre; Je hebt een overtuigend trackrecord in organisatietransformatie, performance management, leiderschapsontwikkeling, cultuur en het professionaliseren van HR. Daarnaast heb je gedegen ervaring met talentmanagement, beloningsstrategie, organisatieontwerp en internationaal schaalbare HR-processen; Je denkt strategisch en neemt als MT-lid verantwoordelijkheid voor de koers en resultaten van My Jewellery als geheel. Tegelijkertijd blijf je dicht genoeg bij de uitvoering om veranderingen daadwerkelijk te realiseren. Je bent onafhankelijk, analytisch en besluitvaardig, stelt scherpe vragen, maakt duidelijke keuzes en combineert hoge standaarden met oprechte betrokkenheid. Je communiceert uitstekend in het Nederlands en Engels. We zoeken iemand die bewust voor My Jewellery kiest, dicht bij onze boutiques, het distributiecentrum en HQ wil staan en begrijpt dat duurzame performance begint bij mensen, leiderschap en gedrag. Iemand die energie krijgt van ons merk en onze ondernemende mentaliteit, strategisch sterk is en net zo vanzelfsprekend de handen uit de mouwen steekt om verandering in de praktijk te realiseren. Over My Jewellery My Jewellery is een van de snelst groeiende merken en e-commerce bedrijven van Nederland met internationale bekendheid. We ontwikkelen collecties en campagnes die het leven van vrouwen een beetje mooier maken. Met meer dan 1.000 collega’s bouwen we elke dag aan een merk vol ambitie en creativiteit. Onze cultuur? Persoonlijk, betrokken en sprankelend. Jij mag hier helemaal jezelf zijn en krijgt de ruimte om te groeien, te leren en impact te maken. Ondanks onze sterke, internationale groei blijven de lijnen kort, de structuur plat en het saamhorigheidsgevoel op hoog niveau. Als team proberen we iedere dag het verschil te maken!

review_candidates.title: Food Security and Livelihoods (FSL) Officer Tempo Inteiro
review_candidates.description: Johanniter-Unfall-Hilfe e.V. International Assistance , is looking for Food Security and Livelihoods (FSL) Officer. Organisation Description Johanniter-Unfall-Hilfe e.V. is a German Christian non-governmental organisation, dedicated to excellence in the field of first aid, ambulance service, social service programmes and other projects in the medical and social field. Johanniter International Assistance (JIA) is the operational unit for humanitarian aid. The Federal Headquarters (HQ) is based in Berlin, Germany. Our Global Strategy 2027 focuses on three programmatic working areas: disaster response and preparedness, health and livelihoods, with climate change and gender equality as crosscutting issues. www.thejohanniter.org. Our commitment to a partnership approach and localisation agenda is based on mutual learning, respect and trust. We prioritise accountability, inclusivity and safeguarding in our work. Overall Job Purpose Under the supervision of the Program Manager – Resilience and Development, the FSL (Food Security and Livelihoods) Officer (Agronomy) will play a critical role in supporting the design, implementation, and monitoring of agronomy-related interventions within the Resilience and Development program. This position aims to enhance agricultural productivity, promote climate-smart agriculture, and improve food security for targeted communities. The Officer will be the focal point on the ground for Johanniter to help coordinate and collaborate with local authorities when required and will work closely with farmers, stakeholders, and local government authorities to ensure effective delivery of sustainable agronomic practices. What you will do Strategy and Vision Actively support the values of Johanniter and thus shapes the country programme accordingly Support the development and implementation of the country strategy in line with JIA strategy Support the development of long-term programming as well as exit strategies Leadership Actively lives and leads by example, upholding the Johanniter leadership principles, supporting wellbeing, and creating a culture where the leadership mindset can emerge and thrive, actively empowering and guiding team members to an inclusive, accountable work environment to achieve shared goals and embrace change. This is reflected in the day-to-day activities in line with the Code Technical responsibilities: Leads the design and implementation of sustainable agronomic practices, focusing on improved farming techniques, soil health, pest management, and climate-resilient crops Supports the identification and introduction of new agricultural technologies and crop varieties that align with community needs and environmental conditions Provides on-the-ground technical support and training to smallholder farmers on best agronomic practices, including seed selection, land preparation, planting, and post-harvest handling Develops and facilitate farmer field schools, workshops, and extension services to enhance knowledge and skills in sustainable farming and climate adaptation techniques Provides tailored technical guidance to farmer cooperatives and local agribusinesses to improve production, processing, and market access Collaborates with relevant stakeholders to create training materials and curricula that reflect local agricultural needs Supports the integration of smallholder farmers into market systems by improving value chain linkages, enhancing access to inputs, and promoting sustainable business models Identifies market opportunities for agricultural products and work with farmers to improve product quality and competitiveness Integrates climate change adaptation strategies into agronomic activities to increase resilience of smallholder farmers against climate-related risks Promotes the adoption of disaster risk reduction techniques and support community preparedness for climate shocks affecting agriculture Engages actively in the beneficiary selection process under the guidance of the Program Manager Monitors the conformity of the field works (trainings, field visits, meeting, etc…) with the standards requirements of Johanniter, and as per the agreed activity planned, BoQs and contracts. Informs and document the anomalies and the challenges carried out during the implementation phase of the program Oversees capacity building of the project team Reporting, Monitoring, Evaluation Accountability and Learning Monitors progress and impact of agronomic interventions through regular field visits, data collection, and reporting Works with the Program Manager and PMEAL team to ensure that project outcomes are aligned with the program’s objectives, and contribute to lessons learned and best practices documentation Prepares regular reports on program progress, challenges, and successes for internal and external stakeholder Conducts household visits, focus group discussions and key informant interviews upon the request of the Program Manager in collaboration with PMEAL Documents field achievements, innovations, failures, and lessons learned to integrate into project activities and inform project strategy Conducts assessments to understand the gaps and opportunities in local agricultural value chains Mobilizes and make communities aware of project objectives, outputs and activities and MEAL systems and Child Safeguarding Policies Visits field regularly, monitor, document and report work progress to the Program Manager on daily and weekly basis Reports possible problem or conflict with possible solutions during the activities. Reports the use of materials and possible improvement Representation, liaison and coordination Coordinates with the local stakeholders on best implementation including participants, local farmers and communities benefitted by the project activities Coordinates with local authorities and ensuring continuous communication with beneficiaries, agriculture department and communities’ representatives regarding the implementation of works and in order to ensure a flawless progress of activities Supports in building relationships between Johanniter, district authorities, agriculture department and communities Establishes and maintain strong relationships with local farmers, agricultural groups, government agencies, NGOs, and private sector actors to foster collaboration and knowledge-sharing Represents the organization in technical working groups, coordination forums, and other relevant platforms related to agriculture and food security Facilitates partnerships with research institutions for the development and piloting of new agronomic approaches and technologies What you bring Bachelor’s Degree in Medicine, Nursing, Nutrition, Dietetics, Public Health, or related field. Masters of Public Health is an added advantage. A minimum of 3 years’ relevant work experience in management, coordination; implementation of health and nutrition interventions in a humanitarian/development context; conducting health/SRH, nutrition, WASH baseline assessments, rapid humanitarian assessments Experience leading teams in project implementation in a complex international development environment and/or conflict zones Experience of working with international humanitarian donors (USAID-BHA, ECHO, GFFO, BMZ, etc.) and knowledge of their specific requirement. Knowledge of health and nutrition technical standards Proven capacity to negotiate and work with governments and partners Experience in WASH, protection, gender-based violence, mental health support is desirable Previous experience in project location desirable (Cabo Delgado Province). Detail-oriented with good multi-tasking, communication skills, both oral and written Knowledge of English and Portuguese languages is essential (oral and written). Demonstrated ability to work in a multi-cultural environment and establish harmonious and effective working relationships, within and outside Johanniter. What we offer Remuneration: Competitive, attractive remuneration, in line with internal tariff and relevant previous experience Benefits: e.g. 13th month salary, social security; insurance package; friendly and appreciative working atmosphere How to Apply If this is what you are looking for, please submit your application (cover letter, CV, reference contacts of 3 former supervisors, job certificates if available), stating your earliest start date. Please indicate “JUH-MOZ-FSL Officer 09/2026” in the subject line of your e-mail. Email: recruitment.moz@thejohanniter.org Deadline for applications 24/09/2026 Only short-listed candidates will be notified. We may start shortlisting before the closing date. Johanniter is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity irrespective of cultural, religious, social background, gender, age, disability or sexual orientation. We encourage applications from women and people with disabilities. Johanniter employees are expected to act according to our Code of Conduct as well as our Leadership Principles. Please note Johanniter requires background checks (incl. criminal record and reference checks) to protect the vulnerable and prevent abuse. Information regarding the privacy policy for applications can be found here.

review_candidates.title: Director, National Programs
review_candidates.description: The Director of National Programs leads the Native English Program for the Maximo Nivel institute in Cusco, Peru. The National Director is responsible for sales, marketing, client service, class scheduling, diagnostic testing, and matriculation. The Director of National Programs manages a team of 3-5 [shared] office staff. A major component of the position is managing the front office (“the store”) and the daily logistics of opening, closing, cashing out, and selling English classes. It’s also important to generate excitement, both within the National Programs Team and the client base, about providing great client service and meeting matriculation goals every month! Tasks The Director of National Programs works directly with individuals to matriculate them into Maximo’s Native English Program. The Director also works with corporate clients to sell group programs to hotels, banks, restaurants, tour operators, and other businesses. The National Director works very closely with the Academic Director in terms of providing great client service to students and clients, scheduling classes, and maximizing the number of matriculations each month. As a member of the Executive Team, the National Director also works closely with the Country Manager and the Director of International Programs. There are several reports the Director must generate on a regular basis using Microsoft Word and Excel: Daily cash box (receipts), Matriculation per class (“FU Report”), Monthly Class Schedule, and monthly book inventory, among others. The Director is also responsible for setting high standards and enforcing a number of policies including: Matriculation After Exam, Use of ORIGINAL textbooks, “greeting hours,” and pulling non-paying clients out of classes, etc. Targeted, regular work hours are Monday – Friday from 11:00AM to 9:00PM with a 1 hour break for lunch and every other Saturday from 8:00AM to 2:00PM. Note that during the last 2 days of the month and first 3 days of the month, work hours are Monday – Friday 6:45AM to 9:15PM. It is important to note that the Director of National Programs works on an as needed basis, whenever business demands dictate that the Director should be there—the Director should be flexible and prepared for this when needed. Requirements - Bachelor’s Degree; Master’s Degree preferred - TEFL, TESOL, or CELTA Certification preferred - Fluent English; Advanced Spanish required - 3-5 years professional experience, ideally in sales or client service environment - Outstanding administrative and organizational skills; exceptional attention to detail - Excellent computer skills including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, etc. - Strong team skills and a “love” for team training; Must be ready to lead and manage a cross-cultural team. Excellent interpersonal skills; Excellent writing skills. - Focused on results—increasing matriculations and delivering great client service. Adept at setting goals and managing competing priorities. Be the owner of the National Programs area! - Metric driven; able to understand, analyze, and present data to support business decisions. Benefits Free Education and Training Opportunities International Work Environment Full benefits according to Peruvian law

Requisitos e qualificações: Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita; Facilidade para estabelecer relacionamentos e criar conexões; Capacidade de argumentação, negociação e condução de conversas comerciais ; Experiência com atendimento ao cliente, vendas, prospecção ou relacionamento comercial; Perfil proativo, organizado e orientado a metas e resultados; Experiência com follow-ups e gestão de oportunidades comerciais ; Capacidade de identificar necessidades e apresentar soluções de forma consultiva; Organização para controle de contatos, tarefas e pipeline comercial; Conhecimento básico ou experiência com CRM e ferramentas de gestão comercial ; Interesse ou afinidade com o mercado esportivo ; Ensino médio completo; Ensino superior em Administração, Marketing, Comunicação, Gestão Comercial ou áreas correlatas será considerado um diferencial.
